Changes in Nordea’s Group Leadership Team

19-08-2026

Nordea

Nordea announces changes to its Group Leadership Team with appointments in Personal Banking and Business Banking and the merger of the Group Risk and the Group Compliance functions.

Half-year results 2026 and decision on mid-year dividend

16-07-2026

Interim result

Nordea’s return on equity for the second quarter was 15.9%, reflecting strong performance and high profitability. Total income was up 4% year on year.
